purpose: 본편 컷 자동 생성(Omni Flash · 초 단위 지시문)

items.name: c01
items.prompt:
Vertical 9:16 video, exactly 8 seconds, one continuous shot, no cuts. Handcrafted tabletop miniature diorama photography, tilt-shift shallow depth of field, warm soft practical light. The attached image is the FIRST FRAME: keep every object's shape, size, colour and position consistent with it. The main creature (whenever visible) keeps its exact anatomy and size.
The body is bulbous, loose, and highly flexible, tapering to a small rear tail fin. The skin has a velvety texture covered in fine spines, colored orange-red with bright greenish-yellow mottling. It features a large mouth with a protruding lower jaw. Two small eyes with deep rosy red irises are positioned high on the head. Between the eyes sits a modified dorsal spine acting as a lure with filament bundles. It has two leg-like pectoral fins extending laterally and smaller pelvic fins underneath used for resting on the seafloor.

TIMELINE
0.0-1.2s: High-angle tilt-shift wide shot looking down into a wooden display box. The miniature seabed is made of crumpled blue cellophane and paper-cut rocks. From the very first second, the chunky, orange-red clay creature with greenish-yellow mottling actively crawls forward a few steps using its leg-like pectoral and pelvic fins. 
1.2-3.1s: The camera slowly pushes in slightly. The creature shifts its weight onto its small pelvic fins underneath its bulbous body, settling its large mouth and protruding lower jaw into a resting posture among the paper rocks. 
3.1-8.0s: The camera holds steady. The creature rests quietly on the handcrafted seabed, its velvety, fine-spined skin illuminated by a warm desk lamp casting soft shadows. Cotton-wool marine snow hanging on fine threads remains motionless. The upper quarter of the frame remains a calm, uncluttered painted cardboard backdrop.
SOUND: none needed (it will be replaced). No music. No dialogue.
NEVER SHOW: text, letters, numbers, symbols, labels, logos, watermarks; real human hands, fingers or people; extra or different creatures; the main creature growing, shrinking or changing shape; morphing or melting objects; cuts, jump cuts or flicker.
